# Implementation progress

This is the single status ledger. Done requires original-gate evidence; fake or
analog fixtures cannot satisfy a real-storage gate. Every implementation slice
adds evidence here in its enclosing Jujutsu change.

## Tasks and gates

M11.4 reopens the M11 aggregate for installation Projects UI qualification. M12
retains its original completed prerequisites M11.1-M11.3: native storage,
authorized commands and repository browser acceptance. The additional hub and
shared-package release qualification does not alter those original Git gates.

The user reopened production browsing integration on 27 September 2026 after
accepting the Storybook application. M4.9–M4.14 now own promotion into the
served browser, missing bounded read contracts, cached controller state,
hash/SSE navigation, virtualization/layout persistence and cold real-repository
acceptance. M4.15 owns repository command search, M4.16 owns the shared durable
mutation workflow and core command controls, and M4.17 owns native conflict
editing. Stories remain visual-pending.

On 28 September 2026 the user narrowed the first application release to
LocalTrusted access, persistent embedded RustFS and macOS local application
acceptance. The unreleased server accepts configuration format 2 only; older
configuration compatibility and migration are removed. Authenticated/shared
deployment, external S3 authority, RustFS replication, verified backup and
restore, generic-S3/MinIO qualification, Linux packaging, authority migration,
failover, promotion, Git, Nostr and Smart HTTP are deferred future-release work.
M4's registry/package and shared-deployment finalization is also deferred;
functional local browser acceptance is owned by M8a.1 and does not require
package publication or visual baselines. Explicitly configured LocalTrusted
search is part of the local application and uses no bearer credential.

M9 implements the accepted repository-native agent and review plan for the
LocalTrusted application. The first release defines exact Codex, Cursor and
OpenCode contracts; local qualification enables Codex and OpenCode. The active
capture extension qualifies pinned Cursor CLI 2026.09.26-dd393fe; the default
CLI wrapper's newer version remains unsupported and Desktop live qualification
remains pending. It includes exact immutable review anchors and live
collaboration hints while code remains pinned until explicit refresh. Reviews
prepare explicit task context; controller job dispatch is deferred.
Authenticated/shared access, remote replication, backup/restore, Git/Nostr
export, other harnesses, CRDT identity and visual baselines remain deferred.

M10 implements local-first writable replication. Normal native, AgentStore and
ReviewStore operations use complete local storage after hydration, while one
configured authenticated hub exchanges original publications in the background.
The release includes non-destructive migration of existing direct-remote
workspaces. M10.7 activates the useful server-owned background profile with
durable peer checkpoints, memory-only credentials, local outage readiness,
native controls, finite waits and SSE/search freshness. M10.8 defers expanded
pressure and fault soak, browser replication UI, cold two-instance real-RustFS
replication, pressure archive/export tooling and additional deployment topology
qualification. Passive backup, automatic promotion, distributed destructive
operation-log pruning and executor failover remain separate work.

M12 qualifies the explicit native Git bridge through GB0-GB6 on macOS ARM64 with
pinned JJ 0.45.1, gix 0.87.1 and Git 2.55.0 under the SHA-1 bookmark profile.
The final cold cycle uses actual persistent RustFS and the served browser;
generated credentials qualify HTTPS/SSH fixture transport. Tag publication,
signing/conflict export, native Git import/export and other platforms and
external forge deployment qualification remain deferred. WorkStore local Git is
supported while its replication stays frozen. M13 adds the separate server-free
companion profile; its partial delivery does not qualify local serving/UI or
conversion. The pending capability gates are explicit in
[local-jj.md](local-jj.md#pending-capabilities-and-acceptance).

and named tests are checked by the progress gate.

    "formats": "No pending entry, request/receipt, cursor journal, native alias, source registry or sanitizer format changes.     "revision": "enclosing Jujutsu change utqtmyyt",
    "scope": "One pending-proof recovery surface validates the admitted channel, physical/header witness, configured product/parser, native UUID, exact complete ending offset and prefix SHA-256, deterministic batch/observation identities and contiguous row count. At most 4 MiB is scanned per step with at most 1 MiB partial bytes and 256 trailing contexts; mixed ranges, incomplete endings, changed witnesses and rewritten prefixes cannot publish. Queued B body from header A uses independently current B directory/socket/catalog and native Write admission. Only exact constant omissions may use separately admitted matching prior/header/current anchor candidates; fallback never grants body admission. Revocation, missing/replaced/rewritten files and lost native Write preserve exact pending intent. Exact-entry draining cannot lend one recovered directory proof to another batch in the same partition; A/B/A queue recovery proceeds in source order before new reading. The live driver resumes latest sanitized durable progress under unchanged physical/source leases only on a later step, so reopen failure cannot discard a committed receipt. Complete direct runtime/native/CLI consumers and focused package checks/lint/format/boundaries qualify the shared context callback and reader/publication consumers. Five final proof cases plus the other 66 runtime primary cases, 14 native server and 26 direct CLI cases pass, with subprocess fixtures explicitly exercised by parents. Initial regression and fixture/lint failures are retained above with their fixes. Restart acquisition still requires current qualified header-directory admission before source leases; alternate queued-directory acquisition remains supervisor composition scope. M17.2 and aggregate M17 remain In progress. Fair bounded blocking-I/O supervision, deadlines/backpressure/pause/restart and controls, legacy absent-domain initialization, Cursor/OpenCode readers, live harness edits and cold full-flow, UI and the full M17.3-M17.7 roadmap remain pending. Enabled startup guard stays in place. No model/wire, native/WAL implementation, browser lifecycle, installed services, credentials, publication, release or deployment changed; root aggregate and unrelated wider lanes remain out of scope."

    "formats": "Opaque in-memory physical/header fingerprint, read-only exact queued recovery, compact EOF/metadata probes, independent forked spool handles and retained generic owned executors.     "scope": "One bounded explicit Codex supervisor surface composes configured root resolution, one-candidate owned discovery, opaque overlap/hardlink deduplication, genuine activity/current-context admission, parked independent ingress and exact native delivery. It tracks the configured source bound, caps concurrently occupied source owners at one through four, separately caps noncompact source frames at twice that bound and caps retained independent partition recovery frames at twice that bound. EOF compaction releases partial allocation without losing cutoffs, hashes, active proof or exact unacknowledged batches; unchanged compact readers perform metadata/current-admission/progress checks without re-leasing. Noncompact multi-step proofs survive turns. Independent retained blocking owners make ordinary runtime/status/pause responsive while stalled synchronous I/O stays owned; cancellation retains reservations until settlement, and shutdown has one five-second bound. B delivery progresses while A directory I/O is stalled or A exact long proof is withheld; same-partition order and exact prepared retry remain existing authority. A stale queue snapshot, in-flight work or a non-EOF partial scan cannot report caught-up. Shared in-process journal and source-acquisition FIFO prevents deterministic local lock-collision starvation while every operation still obeys OS leases and current Write. Disabled preparation does no source I/O. All before/expanded fixture, lifecycle and lint failures are retained and fixed; temporary static diagnostics were removed. Shared spool/gate behavior affects both native server and CLI consumers, justifying the complete capture runtime and direct publication/spool/provenance/recovery lanes; unrelated UI/model/whole-Rust-workspace and root aggregate lanes remain out of scope. M17.2 and aggregate M17 stay In progress. Pending gates include saturated backpressure/revocation/requalification and source rotation/retirement pressure/fault coverage, revoked parked ingress-anchor/current-directory handoff, deadline/drain faults across all supervisor lanes, configured process startup and ordered storage shutdown, legacy missing AgentStore initialization, Cursor/OpenCode readers, authenticated controls, coverage/backlog UI and real harness/cold acceptance; M17.3-M17.7 remain pending. Automatic enabled startup stays guarded. No installed service, daemon restart, code heads, credentials, harness process, checkpoints, release, deployment or publication changed. In-flight delivery status reports the reserved frame upper bound until settlement, stopped owners report zero frames and lost source owners invalidate cached caught-up. Full source task-loss requalification remains an explicit future fault gate."
